headline: Antibody-antigen structures and databases reveal convergent binding and immune escape
label: Protein Interaction Resources
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational analysis of molecular recognition at scale, where curated interaction data or structures are paired with quantitative readouts. ASD standardizes 1,097,946 unique antibody-antigen interactions across 9,575 antigens from 15 sources, including affinity and binding annotations. Analysis of more than 1,100 SARS-CoV-2 antibody structures identifies convergent paratopes and near-universal escape by variants such as KP3.1.1. The signal peptide study applies structure-based optimization to pathogen sequences for antigen expression in humans, a design-oriented application that shares this methodological framing rather than the same data type. What is new is the scale of standardized interaction data in ASD and the structural convergence observed across SARS-CoV-2 antibodies. The items are heterogeneous, so the shared thread is methodological rather than a single application.
